description: This file contains functions and types related to channel setup prompts, including configuring actions, account IDs, and DM policies within a chat or communication platform.

methods.name: formatAccountLabel
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for an account ID, indicating if it is the default account.

methods.name: promptConfiguredAction
methods.description: Prompts the user to select an action (update, disable, delete, skip) for a configured channel.

methods.name: promptRemovalAccountId
methods.description: Prompts the user to select an account ID for removal, considering multiple accounts and default.

methods.name: maybeConfigureDmPolicies
methods.description: Interacts with the user to configure DM access policies for selected channels, updating the configuration accordingly.
